attributes.name: Fire Spells
attributes.description: Wield the destructive and empowering forces of flame.

spells.name: Hearth & Home
spells.description: Casting Time: 10 minutes. Conjure a welcoming inn, complete with sturdy wooden tables, plush chairs, and a soft rug underfoot. At its heart burns a cozy fire in a fireplace, filling the space with warmth and light. The inn lasts for 12 hours and vanishes without a trace afterward.

spells.name: Fire Step
spells.description: Casting Time: 1 minute. Teleport to a fire source you can see.

spells.name: Firebrand
spells.description: Touch a surface and secretly mark it with a symbol or brief message. Speaking a chosen command word while nearby reveals it.

spells.name: Flame Dart
spells.damage: 1d10. On crit: Smoldering.

spells.name: Heart's Fire
spells.description: (1/round) Give an ally 1 action. Cast as a Reaction for 1 mana.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.description: Conjure a minor visual illusion. OR: Ignite a small, unheld item within Reach 6.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.damage: 4d10 to a Smoldering target.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon
spells.description: A weapon you choose inflicts Smoldering on crit and gains (1/turn) +KEY damage.

spells.name: Flame Barrier
spells.description: Castable only while Defending. Triggers whenever you are attacked this round.
spells.damage: 10+KEY and Smoldering.

spells.name: Pyroclasm
spells.damage: 2d20+10 on a failed DEX save (Smoldering creatures fail); half on save.

spells.name: Fiery Embrace
spells.description: An ally gains the effects of Enchant Weapon. Enemies gain Smoldering, and effects that would end it, don't.

spells.name: Living Inferno
spells.description: Gain the effects of Flame Barrier until your next turn. At the end of this turn and your next turn, cast Pyroclasm for free.

spells.name: Dragonform
spells.description:
Transform into a Huge dragon. Gain 3 actions, a flying Speed of 12, LVL Defense, 10×LVL temp HP, and:

* **Tooth & Claw.** 1 Action: (Reach 2) 1d20+LVL damage (ignoring armor). Inflicts Smoldering.
* **Immolating Breath.** 2 Actions: (Cone 10, AoE) KEY d20 damage, half on DEX save (Smoldering targets fail).

You can maintain this form for as long as the temp HP granted by this spell remain (max. 10 minutes). When it ends, you drop to 0 HP.

attributes.name: Ice Spells
attributes.description: Command the freezing cold to hinder and shatter your foes.

spells.name: Cryosleep
spells.description: Creatures in a 2×2 area within Reach are Dazed. On a failed STR save, they fall asleep instead, becoming Incapacitated until their next two turns have passed, until damaged, or until an ally uses an action to wake them.

spells.name: Cryotomb
spells.description: A target must make a STR save or become incapacitated in an icy tomb and immune to harm. This lasts as long as you remain alive, or until the ice melts or is otherwise destroyed. The creature may repeat the save once every 10 days. Huge or larger creatures have advantage on the save. A Small or Tiny creatures, disadvantage.

spells.name: Chillcraft
spells.description: **Chill:** Harmlessly freeze, thaw, or move a bath-sized amount of water near you. OR: **Craft:** Conjure a sheet of opaque, mirror-like, or transparent ice the size of a window or door.

spells.name: Ice Disk
spells.description: Casting Time: 1 minute. Conjure a floating disk of ice that follows you. It can carry moderately heavy weight for 1 hour or until you cast this spell again.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.damage: 1d6 cold/piercing, Slowed.

spells.name: Snowblind
spells.damage: 1d6, Blind until the end of their next turn.

spells.name: Wintry Scrying
spells.description: Casting Time: 1 minute. Turn a small patch of water into a reflective icy mirror. Looking through it grants you vision of any desired location near this body of water for 10 minutes.

spells.name: Frost Shield
spells.description: Castable only while Defending. Gain 2×KEY temp HP. The temp HP are lost at the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.damage: 3d6. ANY die can crit vs a Hampered target. On crit: +20 damage (instead of rolling any additional dice).
spells.upcast: Increase a die roll by 1 and +5 damage on crit.

spells.name: Omenrime
spells.description: Roll 1d6; you may replace any single die rolled within Reach with that die (it expires at the end of the encounter if unused). Exchange the original die with the d6 that you rolled; treat it exactly as if that die were the one originally rolled.

spells.name: Rimeblades
spells.description: Conjure icy blades in 5 contiguous spaces; this area is Difficult Terrain. Creatures there (or who enter later) suffer 2d6 damage for each space they touch.

spells.name: Arctic Blast
spells.damage: 4d6+10. This area is Difficult Terrain for 1 round. Any already Hampered creatures there are Restrained (frozen in place).

spells.name: Glacier Strike
spells.damage: d66 bludgeoning to creatures in a 3×3 area. Creatures adjacent to that area take half as much. The entire area permanently becomes Difficult Terrain.

spells.name: Arctic Annihilation
spells.description: Any targets you choose are encased in ice and immune to damage and negative effects until the start of their next turn. All others take d66 damage, then make a STR save or be Incapacitated until the end of their next turn. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before using it again.

attributes.name: Lightning Spells
attributes.description: Channel the raw power of storms and electricity.

spells.name: Sparkfetch
spells.description: Loudly teleport a tiny, unheld metal item you can see to yourself.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Casting Time: 10 minutes. You and up to 10 willing creatures within 2 spaces are instantly teleported to a place of your choice that you have visited before.

spells.name: Overload
spells.description: Castable only if Charged, ending the condition.

spells.name: Spark Buddy
spells.description: Casting Time: 1 minute. Conjure a Tiny (squirrel-sized) helper for up to 1 hour. It can fetch Tiny objects, open unlocked doors, illuminate a small area, or deliver a harmless shock. If it takes damage or moves further than 6 spaces away from you, it dissipates into sparks.

spells.name: Spark Step
spells.description: Reach: 4. Teleport to a metal object.

spells.name: Tempest's Command
spells.description: Dispel a minor magical effect, or temporarily suppress a stronger one (the more powerful an enchantment, the shorter the duration). OR: Your eyes glow and your voice is amplified to a thunder-like volume for 1 minute.

spells.name: Zap
spells.damage: 1d8+4. On miss: you take half the damage instead.

spells.name: Arc Lightning
spells.damage: 3d8. Also hits the next closest creature.
spells.description: If you are the closest, you are hit! If 2 creatures are equally close, the GM can select randomly, the taller one, or whoever has the most metal.

spells.name: Alacrity
spells.description: (1/turn) Teleport up to your Speed, gain Charged (can be cast while Defending, after damage).

spells.name: Stormlash
spells.damage: 3d8+4 and Prone on a failed STR save. Creatures with a large amount of metal (e.g., armor or a longsword) roll with disadvantage and suffer +10 damage.

spells.name: Electrickery
spells.description: Castable when an ally is attacked. Teleport an ally away. Teleport another creature there on a failed WIL save (making them the target). Costs 1 action if Charged, ending the condition.

spells.name: Electrocharge
spells.description: Give a creature Charged, +1 max action, +5 Defense, 2× Speed, and advantage on DEX saves.

spells.name: Ride the Lightning
spells.description: Teleport to a spot you can see (if a willing creature is there, swap places with them). Adjacent creatures take d88 damage and Knockback 2. Creatures moved 2+ spaces are also knocked Prone, Dazed, and deafened for 1 day.

spells.name: Seething Storm
spells.description: Become a cloud of tempestuous storm. You can fly, move for free 1/round, and attacks against you are disadvantaged. At the end of each of your turns, strike up to 4 creatures within Reach with a bolt of lightning for d88 damage (a creature can only be struck 1/round). Costs 3 actions each round to maintain. +2 Reach and +2 lightning bolts each round. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before you can use it again.

attributes.name: Necrotic Spells
attributes.description: Draw upon the forces of death and shadow.

spells.name: Shadow Blast
spells.damage: 1d12+KEY. 1/round.

spells.name: Summon Shadow
spells.description: Summon a shadow minion within Reach 1 (you can summon a max of INT or LVL minions this way, whichever is lower). Your shadow minions follow the normal minion rules: they have 1 HP, no damage bonus, and do not crit. They abandon you immediately outside of combat. **Action:** (1/turn) you may command ALL of your minions to move up to 6 then attack (Reach 1, d12 each).

spells.name: Memory Veil
spells.description: Conceal or change all memories of an event for up to 12 creatures within 2 spaces on a failed WIL save for as long as this spell lasts.
spells.concentration: Ss long as the caster remains conscious.

spells.name: Greater Shadow
spells.description: Summon a 5d12 Greater Shadow minion (max 1) adjacent to you. When it dies, it explodes into 5 shadow minions (see Summon Shadow). Place them anywhere within 8 spaces.

spells.name: Speak With Dead
spells.description: Temporarily animate a corpse, allowing it to answer up to 3 questions before returning to rest. The corpse must answer, but it isn’t required to be truthful if it dislikes the questioner or the questions.

spells.name: Entice
spells.damage: 1d12 (ignoring armor). Target moves Primary Die spaces closer to you and gains 1d12 damage on their next attack.
spells.description: 1/round.

spells.name: False Face
spells.description: Casting Time: 1 minute. Change your appearance to look like someone else for 10 minutes. Requires a piece of them.

spells.name: Gravecraft
spells.description: **Gravemark:** Magically soil a surface with blood, filth, or other disgusting things (1 Action). OR: **Gravework:** Shape/move a body-sized plot of earth (1 Minute).

spells.name: Thought Leech
spells.description: Read the surface thoughts of a creature. They can sense you doing this and may not like it.

spells.name: Withering Touch
spells.damage: 1d12. On damage, target is considered undead for 1 round.

spells.name: Shadow Trap
spells.description: Reaction: When an enemy moves next to an ally within Reach. If Small/Tiny, the enemy is also Restrained until they escape.
spells.upcast: +1 size category and +1d12 damage on escape.

spells.name: Dread Visage
spells.description: Castable only while Defending. Frighten all creatures attacking you in melee this round. Costs 2 mana less while Dying.
spells.damage: 1d12 to all creatures attacking you in melee this round.

spells.name: Vampiric Greed
spells.description: Heal HP equal to the damage dealt then gain 1 Wound. Gain 1 additional Wound for each creature that survived this damage.

spells.name: Vigor Mortis
spells.description: Castable only when an ally drops to 0 HP. Their max actions do not change, they skip STR saves to act, and taking damage while Dying causes 1 fewer Wound (min 1).

spells.name: Gangrenous Burst
spells.damage: 3d20 (ignoring armor) to damaged creatures on a failed STR save (target rolls with disadvantage if Bloodied), half on save.

spells.name: Unspeakable Word
spells.damage: d66 with advantage (ignoring armor).
spells.description: On a failed INT save (disadvantage if Bloodied or Frightened) the target is Weakened 10, and you are Empowered 10 on your next attack. On save, the opposite happens instead.

spells.name: Creeping Death
spells.damage: 4d20. If this kills the creature, repeat the damage to another creature within Reach 8 of it not yet damaged by this effect. Repeat until a target survives or no others are within Reach.

attributes.name: Radiant Spells
attributes.description: Harness divine light to heal, protect, and punish.

spells.name: Lifebinding Spirit
spells.description: Summon a spirit companion that follows you and is immune to harm. It lasts until you cast this spell again, take a Safe Rest, or it heals a number of times equal to the mana spent summoning it. **Action:** It attacks or heals a creature within Reach 4. It attacks for 1d6+WIL radiant damage (ignoring armor), or heals for the same amount.
spells.upcast: Increment its die size by 1 (max d12), +1 healing use.

spells.name: Radiant Bond
spells.description: Telepathically communicate across any distance with a creature that holds a gift you have freely given.

spells.name: Revive
spells.description: Casting Time: 1 hour. Bring a dead creature back to life, provided they’ve been dead no more than 10 days and have not been revived by this spell before. Attempting to revive a creature already brought back with this spell risks raising a mindless, zombified husk instead.

spells.name: Beautify
spells.description: Clean stains or repair a small tear/break in a non-magical item, or conjure tiny beautiful things: flowers, butterflies, etc.

spells.name: Bond of Peace
spells.description: **Bond:** Telepathically communicate simple thoughts or feelings with a friendly creature you can see. OR: **Peace:** Imbue your spoken words with calming magic, granting advantage on any check made to soothe anger or fear in creatures who can hear you.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: Cause an item to brightly glow as a torch with radiant light for as long as you hold it.

spells.name: Rebuke
spells.damage: 1d8 (ignoring armor). 2× damage against undead or cowardly (those Frightened or behind Cover).

spells.name: True Strike
spells.description: A target gains advantage (ignoring all sources of disadvantage) and +1 Reach on the next attack they make this encounter.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Heal a target 1d8+KEY HP. If 5+ mana is spent, heal a negative condition as well (e.g., Blind, 1 Wound).

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.description: Make an ally your ward: they take 2 less damage from all sources. (1/round) When they are attacked, you may be attacked for some or all of the damage instead.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.damage: 30. Cannot be reduced by any means. The next attack against that enemy gains advantage.
spells.description: Can only target enemies who crit since your last turn.

spells.name: Shield of Justice
spells.description: Castable only while Defending. Creatures who attack you are Blinded (until the end of their next turn); you deal damage back to each (ignoring armor) equal to damage you take this round.

spells.name: Vengeance
spells.description: Can only target enemies who attacked a Dying ally or reduced one to 0 HP since your last turn.

spells.name: Sacrifice
spells.description: Reduce yourself to 0 HP and you cannot have more than 0 HP until you Safe Rest. Heal an amount of HP equal to your max HP, divided as you choose among any other creatures. You may revive a creature that has died in the past minute if you give them at least 20 HP (also healing 2 Wounds from them), provided they have not been revived with this spell before.

spells.name: Celestial Legion
spells.description:
(1/turn) Any friendly creature may use 1 of 3 charges to call upon higher powers for aid this encounter:

* **Reckoning.** When you attack, gain advantage (ignoring all disadvantage) and add 1d20 damage to the attack; with advantage too, if Bloodied.
* **Trembling.** When attacked, the enemy becomes Frightened of you until the end of their next turn. Reduce the incoming damage by 1d20 if Bloodied.

spells.name: Redeem
spells.description: Casting Time: 1 day. Requires (and consumes) a diamond worth 10,000 gp. Reach: 1 mile. Revive any number of creatures that have died in the past year, provided they have not died of old age or been revived with this spell before.

attributes.name: Wind Spells
attributes.description: Control the air itself to move, protect, and cut.

spells.name: Lesser Windform
spells.description: You are invisible and blinded for the duration of the spell.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.damage: 1d4+INT psychic (ignoring armor). On hit: the target is Taunted during their next turn.

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: Touch a creature, grant a flying speed of 12.

spells.name: Greater Windform
spells.description: Gain invisibility, a flying speed, and the ability to slip through any space that wind can pass through.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.description: Restore 1d4 HP to a Dying creature. If healed for 4+: they also regain 1 action.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.description: Reaction: When a creature falls, cause them to gently float to the ground.

spells.name: Helpful Gust
spells.description: Gently move a Tiny unheld item in any direction. OR: Generate an illusory scent.

spells.name: Razor Wind
spells.damage: 2d4 slashing, with advantage OR include a 2nd creature adjacent to your target.

spells.name: Wind Whisper
spells.description: You whisper a message into the wind and it will be secretly carried to a specified target anywhere wind could reach.

spells.name: Blustery Gale
spells.damage: 3d4 bludgeoning, Knockback 2 (advantage vs flying/Small/Tiny). Forced movement deals +5 damage instead of rolling additional dice.

spells.name: Barrier of Wind
spells.description: Castable only while Defending vs Ranged. Reduce the Primary Die by 3. If it misses, redirect the original attack to another space in Reach.

spells.name: Echoburst
spells.damage: d44 bludgeoning (ignoring armor). Any creature in the targeted space at the beginning of your next turn takes this damage again.

spells.name: Eye of the Storm
spells.damage: 4d4+10 bludgeoning to enemies. Place surviving creatures anywhere within 1 space of the storm's Reach on a failed STR save.

spells.name: Updraft
spells.damage: 20 bludgeoning minus a DEX save to creatures in a 5×5 area. On 10+ damage, they land Prone and Dazed.

spells.name: Thousand Cuts
spells.damage: d44 slashing with advantage. Also damages enemies within Reach 1 of your target.

spells.name: Boisterous Winds
spells.description: Gently move all creatures up to 6 spaces, each in a straight line in a direction of your choice. At the beginning of your subsequent turns, do so again but 2 fewer spaces.
